purpose: Preregister implementation and qualification of the isolated fixed-mass canonical Jacobi coordinate transform and its linear tangent map, without dynamics.

preregistration.commit_message: Preregister M0 Step 3g1b canonical Jacobi primitives
preregistration.required_closeout_message: Qualify M0 canonical Jacobi tangent primitives

specification_reconciliation.step3g0_external_notation: The Step 3g0 primitive graph writes the future adapter as (x,v) to (q,p).
specification_reconciliation.canonical_constraint: Step 3g0 applies ordinary symplecticity only to canonical (q,p) and prohibits treating unweighted (x,v) as canonical.
specification_reconciliation.step3g1b_boundary: This step implements only the lower-level fixed-mass canonical operator (x,p) to (q,P) and its inverse. It neither converts velocity to momentum nor claims to complete the future (x,v) adapter.
specification_reconciliation.future_risk: A later adapter must explicitly define and qualify the fixed-mass velocity-to-inertial-momentum boundary before consuming InertialCartesianState.

canonical_convention.body_order: Exactly CompiledLayout.body_ids; identity is never inferred or reordered.
canonical_convention.mass_rule: One fixed finite positive binary64 mass for every unique layout BodyId, supplied by the exact PhysicalModel; zero, negative, nonfinite, missing, duplicate, and extra masses are rejected by model or plan construction.
canonical_convention.cumulative_mass_rule: eta_0=m_0 and eta_i=fl(eta_(i-1)+m_i), evaluated left-to-right in layout order in binary64; every eta must remain finite and positive.
canonical_convention.relative_coordinate_sign: q_i is body i minus the center of mass of bodies 0 through i-1.
canonical_convention.momentum_inverse: Set prefix_(N-1)=P_0; for i=N-1 down to 1, p_i=P_i+(m_i/eta_i)*prefix_i and prefix_(i-1)=(eta_(i-1)/eta_i)*prefix_i-P_i; finally p_0=prefix_0.
canonical_convention.tangent_forward: Apply the identical fixed A and A^(-T) operators to delta_x and delta_p; masses, identity, configuration, and fingerprints are not differentiated.
canonical_convention.tangent_inverse: Apply A^(-1) and A^T to delta_q and delta_P using the same inverse recurrences.
canonical_convention.axis_order: Each body row is (x,y,z); the operator is applied independently in axis order x,y,z.
canonical_convention.flattened_phase_order: All body-major position rows flattened first, followed by all body-major momentum rows: [x_0x,x_0y,x_0z,...,x_(N-1)z,p_0x,...,p_(N-1)z].

implementation_contract.production_complexity: O(N) time and O(N) detached output storage; no dense matrix construction or multiplication.
implementation_contract.state_api: A new semantically distinct immutable InertialCanonicalState stores (x,p) and model fingerprint; it is not InertialCartesianState (x,v). A matching immutable InertialCanonicalTangentState stores (delta_x,delta_p). Existing CanonicalJacobiState and CanonicalJacobiTangentState remain unchanged.
implementation_contract.application_identity: Every operation receives the exact PhysicalModel and plan; model fingerprint, layout object equality, layout fingerprint, units, state semantic type, and tangent/base compatibility are checked before arithmetic.
implementation_contract.ownership: Inputs are never mutated; constructors normalize to detached tuple-backed binary64 values; outputs and plans are frozen and share no writable aliases.
implementation_contract.serialization: Canonical UTF-8 sorted compact JSON with finite binary64 values encoded by float.hex(); SHA-256 fingerprints exact bytes.

precision_policy.storage_and_arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 through Python float; no long double or decimal in production.
precision_policy.reassociation: The documented prefix, weighted-prefix, and backward recurrence operation order is fixed; algebraically equivalent reassociation is not used in reproducibility tests.
precision_policy.algebraic_claim: The forward and inverse maps are exact inverses algebraically.
precision_policy.representable_claim: Strict equality is required only for separately identified dyadic fixtures whose every intermediate result is exactly representable.
precision_policy.general_claim: General binary64 round trips are bounded, not described as exact.

one_body_identity.requirement: State and tangent forward/inverse maps are strict identities in all axes.

two_body_dyadic.requirement: Direct q0, q1, P0, P1 formulas and independently derived inverse are strict for selected dyadic vectors.

three_body_analytic.requirement: Hand-derived q0, q1, q2, P0, P1, P2 and inverse cover unequal masses, all axes, nonzero COM, and nonzero total momentum.

three_body_dyadic.requirement: Selected exactly representable state and tangent expressions are tested separately from tolerance tests.

independent_oracles.coefficient_source: Tests construct A directly from fractions.Fraction masses and the frozen row formulas without calling any production plan or recurrence helper.
independent_oracles.inverse_source: Tests invert rational A by independent exact Gauss-Jordan elimination, transpose it for momentum, then convert final rational values to binary64.
independent_oracles.dense_phase_matrix: A3=kron(A,I3), S=block_diag(A3,A3^(-T)) in the exact flattened phase ordering.

finite_difference.formula: [T(z+epsilon*delta_z)-T(z)]/epsilon compared with the analytic transformed tangent.
finite_difference.acceptance: All values must be finite; at least one of the first four ladder points must have relative error <= 512*u*max(1,cond2(S)); the minimum relative error over the ladder must satisfy the same floor bound; no monotonic-improvement requirement applies after the empirical minimum because cancellation dominates. Exact independent dense-matrix closure must also pass.

numerical_tolerances.tangent_componentwise: Same rule as state_componentwise with tangent input norms.
numerical_tolerances.tangent_normwise: Same rule as state_normwise with tangent input norms.
numerical_tolerances.determinant: Recorded as a secondary diagnostic only and never substitutes for symplectic residuals.

required_metrics: minimum and maximum mass plus max/min mass ratio
maximum state round-trip component and L2 errors in both directions
maximum tangent round-trip component and L2 errors in both directions
finite-difference absolute and relative errors for every epsilon
forward and inverse symplectic maximum, Frobenius, and norm-scaled residuals

exact_test_selection.selection_rule: Only these literal node IDs may be passed to pytest; wildcard, directory, marker, keyword, and collection-driven selection are forbidden.

safety_contract.lineage: Reuse the qualified Manifest 23 synthetic namespace shell, deny-first MetaPathFinder, strict import allowlist, ctypes.dlopen audit hook, /proc/self/maps checks, audited pytest 8.4.2 identity, exact-node AST verification, and registered-subprocess closure, extended only by the exact Step 3g1b files and harmless sentinel names preregistered here.
forbidden_modules: protected and historical mini_ephemeris physical modules

review_focus: velocity used where momentum is required
common defective helper shared by implementation and oracle
mutable or aliased state and plan values

deterministic_regeneration.json: UTF-8 strict finite JSON, sorted keys, two-space indentation, one trailing LF.
deterministic_regeneration.csv: UTF-8 fixed columns and row order, LF line endings.
deterministic_regeneration.markdown: UTF-8 fixed templates, one trailing LF.
deterministic_regeneration.artifact_hashes: SHA-256 exact bytes; artifact_hashes.json excludes itself.
deterministic_regeneration.fresh_process: Two guarded isolated interpreters with different PYTHONHASHSEED values must emit byte-identical plan probes; two guarded fresh interpreters must generate artifact directories matching each other and the committed destination byte for byte.

acceptance_gates: Manifest 24 is a separate single-file commit before implementation or qualifying test execution.
All 47 preregistered core, integrity, and safe Step 3g1a regression nodes pass, followed by all 6 artifact nodes.
Analytic one-, two-, three-body, dense rational, round-trip, tangent, finite-difference, and full symplectic gates pass under frozen rules.
Ownership, semantic-type, layout, unit, fingerprint, mass, determinism, and isolation gates pass.
The qualified Step 3g1a modules/tests and every inherited protected/historical/archive/trajectory/tag hash remain exact.
Static safety, compilation, guarded import, strict JSON, deterministic regeneration, artifact hashes, git diff --check, reviewed diff, and final clean worktree pass.
No forbidden operation, force/JVP, dynamics, timestep, trajectory, or archive occurs.

classification_rules.STEP3G1B_JACOBI_TANGENT_PRIMITIVES_COMPL: Every frozen analytic, numerical, structural, safety, integrity, review, regeneration, and closeout gate passes within the coordinate-only envelope.
classification_rules.STEP3G1B_JACOBI_TANGENT_PRIMITIVES_FAILE: The campaign executes but one or more transform, tangent, numerical, integrity, or artifact acceptance gates fails without invalidating the controlled baseline.
classification_rules.STEP3G1B_BLOCKED: The baseline, controlling convention, preregistration ordering, inherited integrity, or no-dynamics guarantee cannot be established before qualification.
classification_rules.CANONICAL_JACOBI_TRANSFORMS_QUALIFIED_FO: The fixed-mass canonical coordinate and tangent operators are qualified only as isolated building blocks for a separately preregistered successor primitive.
classification_rules.CANONICAL_JACOBI_TRANSFORMS_NOT_QUALIFIE: A specific implementation, numerical, safety, or evidentiary defect prevents primitive composition.
classification_rules.CANONICAL_JACOBI_CONVENTION_CONFLICT: The Step 3g0 specification or v2 ADR conflicts with the requested convention and implementation stopped before choosing one silently.
classification_rules.CANONICAL_JACOBI_TRANSFORMS_NOT_EVALUATE: Permitted only with STEP3G1B_BLOCKED for a non-convention baseline block.

strict_prohibitions: modifying any qualified Step 3g1a implementation module or test
modifying a protected source, historical manifest, report, artifact, archive, trajectory, or tag
velocity-based Jacobi coordinate implementation or hidden velocity/momentum conversion
physical force or JVP implementation, import, load, invocation, or evaluation
REBOUND or REBOUNDx import or dependency change
Kepler drift, interaction kick, lazy kernel, corrector, WHCKL composition, synchronization, integration, or timestep
IAS15, MEGNO, LCN, tangent rescaling, restart execution, trajectory, archive, performance benchmark, Solar-System state, Stage 4, or 10 Myr command

successor_boundary.allowed_only_after_success: Propose Step 3g1c limited to an isolated two-body Kepler drift and its canonical tangent map.
